Sales Lead Machine ("we", "our", or "us") is dedicated to safeguarding your privacy and ensuring your personal data is handled responsibly in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and UK Data Protection Act 2018.

1. Information We Collect

We collect information to provide business intelligence, sales prospecting, and intent data solutions. This includes:

  • Direct Inquiries: Contact details such as name, corporate email address, phone number, and company name when you request a demo, start a trial, or submit an inquiry.
  • B2B Intelligence Data: Publicly available business professional data (job titles, corporate phone numbers, business domains, and verified corporate emails).
  • Usage Analytics: Anonymous diagnostic telemetry, page views, device type, and referral sources to optimize platform performance.

2. How We Use Your Data

  • Delivering and operating our sales prospecting and data enrichment platform.
  • Processing demo requests, free trials, and responding to enterprise inquiries.
  • Ensuring accuracy and verification of UK and international business contacts.
  • Complying with statutory reporting, accounting, and legal requirements.

3. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR Article 6)

We process business data under Legitimate Interests for B2B direct marketing and corporate intelligence, having conducted comprehensive Legitimate Interest Assessments (LIA). Direct inquiries and newsletter subscriptions are processed under Consent or Performance of a Contract.

4. Data Subject Rights

Under GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, port, or erase your personal data at any time. You may also object to processing for direct marketing purposes.

To exercise your rights, email our Data Protection Officer at: privacy@salesleadmachine.co.uk.

5. Contact Us
